THE STRATEGIC SHIFT

Before vs. After

Before

Asset recycling

  • Lack of creative diversity
  • Unclear what is being tested each week
  • Long cycle for new creative assets (minimum 2-3 weeks)
  • Learnings trapped in individual teams
→
Strategy 2.0

Variable-isolated testing

  • Media Buyer forecasts weekly demand
  • Controlled variables per test
  • Short turnaround time for "quick" asset requests
  • Daily feedback resets the roadmap

HOW TO BUILD VARIATIONS

STATIC DISPLAY ADS

One direction. One RTB. One clear image.

Static display ads follow a dedicated workflow. Every image should make one product direction and one specific reason-to-believe easy to understand.

01CHOOSE THE AD DIRECTION

Start with the commercial lane

Select one product direction before choosing the RTB.

MENOPAUSE BELLY FATWeight-management direction
GUT PROBIOTIC VS. METABOLIC PROBIOTICCategory-comparison direction
02CHOOSE ONE SPECIFIC RTB

Keep the proof focused

Choose one proof job per image. Do not combine multiple selling points.

SCIENCE RTBResearch, ingredients, or study data
MECHANISM RTBHow the product works
SOCIAL PROOF RTBCustomer reviews or KOL quotes
AUTHORITY RTBExpert opinions, SAB quotes, or third-party endorsements
GUARANTEE RTBRisk reversal or purchase reassurance
Science-authority copy and SAB quotes can be sourced from Taylor.
03CREATE THE IMAGE IN ATRIA

Clone relevant competitor's best performers

Find a strong competitor or historical reference, evaluate its lifecycle and quality, then clone the composition in Atria at approximately 90% similarity.

04FINALIZE + UPLOAD

QA before launch

Select the strongest layout, remove unnecessary versions, replace the copy, and check product imagery, numbers, spelling, layout, and launch upload.

WEEKLY OUTPUT TARGETContent Manager (Alexis): Produce 10 new display ads every week.

THE DTC GROWTH POD

Tight Teamwork.
One Shared Strategy.

The Media Buyer owns demand and strategic direction. All other roles in the growth pod support the media buyer by supplying the needed creative type, volume and quality.

DRIVER

Media Buyer

Forecasts volume, leads the daily standup, surfaces gaps, sets test direction, sets content demand and reads the results.

CONTENT PROJECT MANAGER

Content Manager

Breaks down competitors and converts the breakdowns into scripts, storyboards and content asset production briefs.

KOL ASSET SUPPLY

Creator / KOL Team

Content buyer: Sources new KOL content from new and repeat KOLS. Ensure content bought meets demand and requirements (time, quality, volume) for standard and quick requests.

CRAFT

Video Editor

Builds the final video output based on brief combined with studying the visual and editing techniques from competitor best performing content.

ESCALATION

Jimmy + Becky

Deliver new messaging angles, RTB and landing-page content to test. Provide solutions to supply content assets for new creative formats to quickly test in the short term from the China team or external US agencies.
